verdict.rationale: Formant documents several first-party SDKs. The Agent SDK covers on-device telemetry ingestion, commands and teleoperation, and the Python Cloud SDK covers query and ingestion APIs. The official FormantIO/toolkit repo adds a RealtimeSDK for building custom applications. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use, documented language coverage beyond Python, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and SDK depth details such as versioning or typed references.
